name: Late Winter
description: The season of cold and wet. Kapha begins to accumulate in the body.
diet: Favor warm, heavy, oily, and nourishing foods.
Include sweet, sour, and salty tastes.
Avoid cold drinks and raw, light foods.
lifestyle: Practice daily Abhyanga (warm oil massage) with sesame oil.
Stay warm and avoid exposure to cold winds.

name: Spring
description: The season of renewal. Accumulated Kapha liquefies, which can weaken the digestive fire (Agni).
diet: Favor light, easily digestible, and dry foods.
Include bitter, pungent, and astringent tastes.
Avoid heavy, oily, sweet, and sour foods.
lifestyle: Perform dry massage (Garshana) to stimulate lymph.
Engage in regular, moderate to vigorous exercise.
Avoid day sleep as it increases Kapha.

name: Summer
description: The season of heat. Pitta accumulates and Vata begins to increase due to dryness.
diet: Favor sweet, bitter, and astringent tastes.
Drink plenty of cooling liquids, but avoid ice-cold drinks.
Avoid spicy, sour, and salty foods.
lifestyle: Take cool baths and apply cooling essential oils like sandalwood.
Rest during the hottest part of the day.

name: Monsoon
description: The rainy season. Vata becomes highly aggravated, and digestive fire is typically at its lowest.
diet: Favor light, fresh, and warm meals.
Include sour, salty, and a little sweet taste to pacify Vata.
Drink boiled or purified water, often warm.
lifestyle: Maintain a steady, grounding daily routine.
Avoid getting wet in the rain or exposed to cold drafts.

name: Autumn
description: The season of transition. Pitta that accumulated during the monsoon gets aggravated by the returning heat.
diet: Favor sweet, bitter, and astringent tastes to pacify Pitta.
Include cooling and slightly heavy foods.
Avoid heavy, spicy, and sour foods.
lifestyle: Spend time in the moonlight (moon bathing) to cool Pitta.
Purify drinking water using sunlight and moonlight.
Engage in calming activities and avoid anger or stress.

name: Early Winter
description: The season of chill. Digestive fire becomes very strong. Vata is pacified and Kapha begins to build.
diet: Favor rich, nourishing, and heavy foods to satisfy the strong Agni.
Include sweet, sour, and salty tastes.
Consume warm dairy, healthy fats, and root vegetables.
lifestyle: Perform daily self-massage with warm, heavy oils.
Wear warm clothing and seek sunlight.
